notes.title: Manchester Gamers Unite
notes.content:
This month we attended the Manchester Gamers Unite event at Impossible. The purpose of us attending the show was to get feedback and test the latest iteration of the local multiplayer component of the game.

The show was a success for us as the booth was busy all night with gamers of all ages enjoying the competitive aspect of the multiplayer version of the game. We managed to find only a couple of bugs were confident we can squash to make the experience even better.

As well as attending MGU, we’ve been putting some focus into the single player version of the game with us making plans to update the animation system, sound design and implementing the narrative throughout the game.

Many thanks again to Manchester Gamers Unite for offering us a slot at the show. Be sure to follow us on the socials and wishlist the game here on Steam to keep updated.

- Ginger Biscuit Team
